How you cut (or don’t cut) and cook the cloves can affect the pungency of the garlic — and the flavor of the dish you’re cooking.

I have been using a garlic press recently when a recipe says mince or grate (mostly to save my fingers in the mincing process). Is that okay? Seems like older recipes used to specify a garlic press. Is it a cooking fashion question, or is there actually a difference in how a recipe turns out?
